codebook.SUPPORTED: Hypothesis is locally warranted and adds a source-linked distinction at the stated scale.
codebook.QUALIFIED: A real source-linked contribution exists but requires explicit limitation of scope, modality, or family dominance.
codebook.REJECTED: Source evidence or a decisive rival undermines the hypothesis for this passage.
codebook.INSUFFICIENT: Available passage evidence does not justify support or rejection; abstain.

instructions.rule: Judge whether the architectural hypothesis is warranted by the passage, not whether its vocabulary occurs. SUPPORTED requires source-linked discriminative value; QUALIFIED requires a real but bounded contribution; REJECTED requires source-grounded counterevidence; INSUFFICIENT is abstention.
